ig_caption:
Kubernetes CrashLoopBackOff... and there's no bug in the app 🤯

⚠️ the AI app needs 25 s to load its index
⚠️ the liveness probe starts checking immediately: every 5 s, 3 failures → killed
→ killed at 15 s, 10 s before it would have been ready. Again. And again. 5 restarts, CrashLoopBackOff.

Your health check is the thing killing your app.

The fix:
✅ add a startupProbe (here: up to 60 s)
✅ liveness only starts after the app has started

Same app → Running, 0 restarts.

Do you use startup probes? Tell me 👇 Follow for more Kubernetes breaks.

#kubernetes #k8s #devops #sre #genai
yt_title: Kubernetes CrashLoopBackOff: the liveness probe killed it #kubernetes
yt_description:
Real run on a local kind cluster: an app that needs 25 s to start, with a livenessProbe (period 5 s, failureThreshold 3, no initial delay). The kubelet kills it at ~15 s every time → 5 restarts → CrashLoopBackOff.
Events: "Liveness probe failed: connection refused" / "Container api failed liveness probe, will be restarted".
Fix: startupProbe (periodSeconds 5, failureThreshold 12 = up to 60 s). Liveness starts only after startup succeeds → Running, 0 restarts.

Series: Kubernetes in production, what breaks (live). Follow for more.
